items.title: TAKE shares rally 24% in three weeks as company returns to profitability
items.description: The stock hit its 5% upper circuit for a second straight session after TAKE reported a consolidated Q2 FY27 profit of ₹2.21 crore, against a loss of ₹62 lakh a year earlier

items.title: Nvidia shares soar 31% as Jensen Huang's return sparks Wall Street rally
items.description: Nvidia's rally lifted the Nasdaq 100 by 6.5% and the S&P 500 by 4.7%, while shorter-dated Treasury yields and the dollar climbed on bets of a more hawkish Fed

items.title: Stock market holiday: NSE, BSE shut today for Guru Nanak Jayanti
items.description: Stock market holiday today: The markets are closed for trading on account of Guru Nanak Jayanti, also called Prakash Gurpurab, the birth anniversary of the first Sikh Guru.

items.title: Asian shares rally as Huang returns to Nvidia, sparking Wall Street rebound
items.description: Asian markets rebounded sharply after Nvidia shares surged 31.5% on Wall Street, restoring nearly $1 trillion in market value and lifting technology stocks amid easing fears over the AI trade
